app.name: Packrune
app.tagline: The fully free, fully self-hosted, universal artifact repository manager.

landing.headline: One binary. Every format. Forever free.
landing.subhead: Docker, npm, Helm, Go, PyPI, Maven — all in a single self-hosted service that never asks for a license key.
landing.featureFreeBody: Licensed under AGPL-3.0 + Commons Clause. Nobody — not even us — can ever put a price tag on Packrune.
landing.featureFastBody: A single Go binary. Pure-Go SQLite means no CGO, no JVM, no surprises.
landing.featureUnifiedBody: Docker, npm, Helm, Go, PyPI, Maven on day one. One Format interface, no plugin sprawl.
